jobs.description: Darrow Creed Login 78% of our production is already reserved. Book time with our team today. Law Firms Insurance Compliance Research Company About Partnerships Careers Newsroom Events FAQ Login Contact At Darrow , our values define how we operate, collaborate, and drive impact every day. These values are the product of a deliberative democratic process undertaken once every three years by the full assembly of Darrow's people. Any member may put forward a value for consideration. From these proposals, a select number are advanced by secure vote and brought before the assembled company, where their sponsors rise to make their case in open address and all present are afforded time to challenge, persuade, and be persuaded. Adoption is rendered by formal physical ballot. This Creed, then, belongs to no single author - it is the law we write together, and the standard by which we hold one another accountable, so that justice may be more than a mission: a practice. People First | We own our culture I put human well-being at the center of everything I do. I’m responsible for practicing and evolving our culture, not just preaching it. I build towards our vision of a justice system everyone can trust. I treat each person as an entire world unto themselves, knowing that within them lies infinite potential beyond any current title, role, or status. I never pull rank on anyone. I care for the people around me. I respect their time. I respect my time. I treat all people with dignity. I put people first. Intentional Communication | I co-own every conversation I join ‍ I approach every conversation with good intentions towards others and towards myself. I declare my intentions and focus on finding a shared purpose with others, knowing every person is different from me. I speak clearly and honestly, so others can access my message easily. I listen. I do not interrupt. I know a smart conversation shares speaking time equally. I actively seek feedback, and openly invite others to speak. I embrace criticism, because our mission matters more than my personal image. I give feedback directly to the recipient. I don’t gossip. I respectfully disagree. I focus on solutions. I always leave room for others to surprise me. I end conversations with an agreement on the next actions. I am an intentional communicator. Partner Centricity | We pursue justice together. I advocate for our partners. I always deliver beyond expectations. I work with urgency, because justice delayed is justice denied. I treat my partners as equals. I know obstacles are part of the path. I approach every interaction with a partner as an opportunity to learn. I fiercely protect partner trust with honesty and transparency. I ensure partners are well informed so they can make the best choices for themselves, driven by explainable data. I am an insider in our partner’s journey, celebrating their success as if it were my own. I think about our partners’ wants before making choices that will affect them. I put our partners at the center of my work. Integrity Honesty & Transparency | I live truthfully. I align my actions with my values. I back my statements with data. I honor my commitments, whether by delivering on time or openly acknowledging when I cannot. I listen to my instincts and speak my truth, even at a cost: no deal is worth our integrity. I encourage others to voice their perspectives. When the stakes are high I appoint a Darrow’s Advocate to develop a contrarian point of view. I reflect on my motivations and ensure potential conflicts of interest are on the table. I own up to my mistakes, do my best to make things right and grow from anything. I live with integrity. Innovation: Radical Foresight | I am a pioneer. I embrace scarcity because hunger feeds creators and uncovers resources. I listen carefully and learn from every person and every experience. I discover value within the seemingly mundane. I know the most exciting phrase isn’t ‘Eureka!’, but ‘That’s funny…’; so I designate time to explore and experiment. I give others autonomy to surprise me, because independent diverse minds cultivate innovation. I support others' ideas and help them grow. I make room by saying “Yes, and”, treating other people’s ideas as if they were my own. I make space for wild ideas to grow wilder. I seek internal resources before external ones. I’m always a learner, not a knower. I reject the status quo, because injustice thrives within indifference. I am an innovator. Detect. Evaluate. Advance. Request a Valuation Memo Lead with Foresight. Darrow's research teams combine legal expertise, AI systems, and large-scale data infrastructure to monitor legal exposure across the areas of law where risk is most consequential. The same intelligence — applied to the specific needs of law firms, insurers, and compliance teams. Antitrust Anti-competitive conduct - from price-fixing to monopolistic behavior - rarely surfaces through a single visible act. Darrow monitors market data, regulatory activity, and behavioral patterns to detect the structural signals of competition risk before they reach enforcement or litigation. Privacy Privacy exposure is growing in scale and complexity, driven by evolving regulation and an expanding digital data footprint. Darrow connects regulatory filings, incident disclosures, and public data signals to surface emerging privacy risk and assess its legal and financial significance. Environment Environmental exposure develops over time - through regulatory noncompliance, accumulating incident data, and physical signals that precede formal action. Darrow monitors environmental, health, and corporate data streams to identify where exposure is forming and how significant it may become. ERISA Fiduciary risk in retirement and benefit plan management is embedded in plan documents, fee structures, and fund performance data that most systems aren’t built to analyze at scale Darrow surfaces discrepancies and emerging fiduciary exposure across plan types, helping legal and risk teams act before obligations compound. Consumer Deceptive practices and consumer harm operate at scale and across jurisdictions, making them difficult to detect through conventional monitoring. Darrow analyzes complaints, regulatory actions, and market behavior to surface patterns of consumer exposure and assess their legal significance across sectors. Labor Systemic labor risk - wage violations, misclassifications, workplace discrimination - tends to emerge from patterns spread across large workforces and jurisdictions. Darrow monitors employment-related data sources to detect where those patterns are forming and assess their scope and severity. Health Medical product liability exposure is difficult to detect because adverse event data is fragmented, unstructured, and distributed across multiple regulatory and clinical sources. Darrow cross-references thousands of data points to identify product-specific risk signals - connecting adverse outcomes, labeling data, and regulatory attention into a coherent picture of emerging exposure. Securities Financial misconduct builds over time - through misleading disclosures, irregular trading patterns, and risk concealed in the fine print. Darrow monitors filings, investor communications, trading data, and regulatory signals to detect fraud indicators before they reach enforcement or become public. 50+ Legal Exposure Categories. One intelligence infrastructure. Darrow's coverage spans the areas where legal risk is most consequential and is continuously expanding as our research teams develop new detection models across emerging domains. Talk to Our Team Detect. Evaluate. Advance. Request a Valuation Memo Lead with Foresight. Deliver with Impact. Justice Through Intelligence See Risk Earlier. Act Before It Escalates.
